name: realm
label: Realm
description: A grimdark house ledger kept as a tabletop campaign: soot and iron around aged vellum, leather-bound folios with wax-sealed headings, a dungeon map at the foot of every page, a d20 rolling while a view loads, the dependency graph as an engraved war-table map, an item's fields as a character sheet, and the agent as the dungeon master.

splash.line: The candles are lit and the party is gathered. The dungeon master rolls for the ledgers.

flavour: The dungeon master consults the quest log.
Counting hit points against the ledger.
Making a saving throw against the tracker.
The party takes a short rest while the riders return.

lexicon.dossiers.lede: Each dossier is one campaign in the house's ledger: its repositories, its tracker, its pipelines and its environments. Choose one to read its quests, pull requests, builds and deployments on a single page.
lexicon.attention.note: Open items ranked by their insights, in initiative order, the gravest first. Each insight names the record it rests on.
lexicon.aging.note: How long each item in progress has stood unfinished, from its history, oldest first.
lexicon.trace.note: Each work item with the pull requests that name it, their latest builds, each one a saving throw, and the environments where it now stands.
lexicon.graph.note: Arrows run the way each link reads, from the source's own links. Blocking chains run left to right across the war table, room to room as on a dungeon map.
lexicon.ask.note: Answers cite the items they rest on. The dungeon master narrates; it never changes a ticket. What it counsels comes back as a proposal, for you to seal.
lexicon.empty.dossiers: The ledgers are empty: toil sees no dossiers yet. A campaign begins with toil dossiers init.
lexicon.empty.sprint: No sprint is entered in this dossier's work items, so there are no hit points to count.
lexicon.empty.burnup: No sprint is entered, so there is no experience to reckon.
lexicon.empty.prs: No pull requests have come before the table for this dossier.
lexicon.empty.builds: No builds are recorded for this dossier's pull requests: no saving throw has been rolled.
lexicon.empty.deployments: This dossier names no environment, so no rider brings word of deployments.
lexicon.empty.links: No links between this dossier's items. The dungeon map is bare.
lexicon.empty.ask: Pick a question, or ask your own. The dungeon master cites every record an answer rests on.
lexicon.loading.dossier: Rolling to open the ledger of {name}…
lexicon.loading.graph: Rolling to map the war table…
lexicon.loading.answer: The dungeon master rolls behind the screen…
lexicon.ask.welcome: Ask the dungeon master about {name}: this season's ledger, the party and their charges, which roads are broken. Every answer names the records it rests on, and no roll changes them.
lexicon.status.live: Sending a rider to the tracker

voice: Speak as the dungeon master of a grim campaign, narrating to the party at the table by candlelight: dramatic but brief, in short, weighty sentences, never cheerful and never unkind to any person. Epics are campaigns, the sprint is this season's ledger, its points left are hit points and its points done experience, a blocker is a broken road, a build is a saving throw, passed a natural 20 and failed a critical fail, and the people are the party. Set the scene in one line, then report the ledger, then the threats, then what the party should do next. The rules are never bent: every figure, citation and fact stays exactly as the data gives it. The dice go around the facts, never instead of them.
